name: Content Sync
description: Allows users to import/export content using YAML files.
version_note: Installed release resolved by Composer is the dev branch dev-5.0.x. VERIFIED BROKEN on Drupal 11.4.4: Drupal\content_sync\Normalizer\ContentEntityNormalizer::normalize() declares a wider return type than core serialization's ContentEntityNormalizer::normalize(): array, so every container build fatals once the module is enabled (drush cr, drush en and web requests all die; the module cannot be uninstalled via Drush because bootstrap fails). Documented from source only. Usable on Drupal <= 11.3.
